title: Robot Avocado Cannon: Momentum Conservation Lab
description: A robot stands on a frictionless platform holding a cannon that launches avocados. Each fired avocado transfers momentum to the robot, pushing it backward on the platform according to conservation of momentum. The user adjusts launch angle, velocity, and avocado mass multiplier, fires projectiles, and uses undo/redo to explore how different parameters affect the system's total momentum.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load robot.glb centered on a flat frictionless platform (a long glossy box, 20 units long) and Avocado.glb as projectile template. Camera starts at (8,5,8) looking at origin. Add hemisphere light (sky 0x88aaff, ground 0x443322) plus a directional light with shadows. Implement a physics simulation: the robot has mass 50kg and sits on the platform with zero friction. A GUI panel (HTML overlay) provides: (1) launch angle slider 10-80 degrees, (2) launch velocity slider 5-30 m/s, (3) avocado mass multiplier slider 0.5x-3x (base mass 1kg), (4) a FIRE button, (5) UNDO and REDO buttons, (6) a RESET button. When FIRE is pressed, clone the avocado model, position it at the robot's arm, and launch it as a projectile with the configured angle and velocity. Apply conservation of momentum: robot recoil velocity = -(avocado_mass * launch_velocity * cos(angle)) / robot_mass cumulatively. Animate the robot sliding backward on the platform accordingly. Avocados follow parabolic trajectories under gravity (g=9.8) and land on a ground plane below. Display a real-time HUD showing: total system momentum (should remain zero), robot velocity, number of avocados fired, and total kinetic energy. Each fire action is recorded in a history stack. UNDO reverses the last fire (removes last avocado, restores robot position/velocity). REDO re-applies it. The robot should visually tilt slightly backward on each shot for feedback. Clamp robot position to platform bounds; if it reaches the edge, show a warning. After 10+ avocados the platform edge should be reachable. Use requestAnimationFrame for smooth 60fps animation of all projectiles simultaneously. Add a subtle grid on the ground for spatial reference.
